text:
sec-bot: Detector: KMS-wrapped object with embedded high-entropy block found in gs://partner-drop/day1/2026-04-05/blob.enc using key projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/ingest/cryptoKeys/ingest-wrap :warning:

amy: @rahul @carmen please triage. Scanner says base64 inside matches AWS key pattern, wrap was server-side (our key).

rahul: looking. Metadata shows ingest service called KMS Encrypt at 08:42 UTC. That implies the plaintext was uploaded unencrypted first. Probable cause: partner CI or collector sent secret in clear.

carmen: quick containment plan:
- revoke partner SA key (rahul)
- create new key version for ingest-wrap and promote to primary (rahul)
- run rewrap job to migrate ciphertext to new version (rahul+carmen)
- add temporary IAM deny for partner uploads to this prefix (carmen)
- patch ingest to require client-side envelope encryption + redact logs (carmen)
- preserve evidence & notify partner/legal (amy/legal-bot)

rahul: revoking now. command (sanitized):
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable 9f8e7d6c --iam-account=svc-partner-uploader@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Added deny for storage.objects.create; uploads stopped at 08:45 UTC.

rahul: creating new KMS key version and scheduling rewrap. Plan: decrypt with old version, re-encrypt with new primary, write to gs://partner-drop/rewrapped with metadata rewrap=true. Estimated 2h for the critical prefix.

carmen: opening PR to enforce client-side AES-GCM envelope encryption and strip full-body logs. PR link (internal): /ingest-agent/pulls/1337. Will gate rollout until rewrap finishes to avoid double-encrypt issues.

amy: legal-bot, please create an evidence hold and draft partner notification. Keep disclosure minimal.

legal-bot: Evidence hold created CASE-2026-198. Draft sent to amy for review.

carmen: starting rewrap for most recent shard, 0/80 objects processed. I'll throttle to avoid KMS quota.

rahul: after rewrap completes we must rotate any downstream IAM tokens that reference these objects and ask teams to confirm they removed copies from CI logs. I'll produce a CSV of principals that accessed the prefix in last 72h.

amy: owners and ETA: rahul (SA revoke + key-version create + rewrap) now -> rewrap ~2h; carmen (ingest PR + log redaction) PR in 15m, rollout after rewrap; amy (legal + partner contact) 1h. Update here with blockers. :white_check_mark:
